title: The cosmological necklace problem
summary: We investigate 3d de Sitter axion wormhole which contribute to the no-boundary density matrix. We identify "cosmological necklace" solutions: an infinite series of Euclidean saddles corresponding with repeated bounces. This results in an unbound gravitational entropy, and a divergent path integral. To remedy this, we study the gravitational path integral using a (mostly) Lorentzian lapse contour.
